findings.detail: Require channel_map list of exact ints, and calibration/validation_source_ids nonempty lists of nonempty strings; set/len alone accepts malformed-but-hashable objects.
Gain minimum must bound absolute applied decoder denominator ghat, not just true gain, for displayed inverse-gain bound.
Use explicit kA=sqrt738137/4096>=||A||2; an upper limit on kA alone does not establish operator domination.
